data.exact_reserve_text: During 2019 the Syndicate released $38.3m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2018: $47.0m), arising predominantly from the Marine, Energy and Property divisions (2018: primarily from the Treaty, Energy and Marine Divisions). These releases were due to favourable claims development on prior year losses during 2019.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a modest release of prior year technical reserves in 2019 of $38.3m (release  1.53% of opening gross claims outstanding $2,503.5m). The releases were attributed predominantly to favourable claims development, primarily in the Marine, Energy and Property divisions. 2019 experienced significant catastrophe activity (notably typhoons Faxai and Hagibis and hurricane Dorian) but prior-year reserve run-off was overall positive due to improved development on earlier losses.

data.data_quality_notes: Amounts are reported in the syndicate's presentation currency (USD). Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Technical Reserves reconciliation (At 1 January 2019: Claims outstanding $2,503.5m). Prior year movement taken from 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' which states a release of $38.3m (explicit). Some event impacts are provided only as aggregates (e.g. 2019 events aggregate $193.2m gross) so individual event amounts are not available and are set to null. LOB-level reserve movements were described as 'predominantly from the Marine, Energy and Property divisions' but not quantified by line; those amounts are null. A gross claims development triangle is present in the note but not fully transcribed here; detailed cell extraction was not completed, so claims triangle output is omitted.
